title: Oracle Access Management CustomReadServlet Directory Traversal Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Oracle Access Management. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of the ContextValue parameter provided to the CustomReadServlet endpoint. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise.
